name: Shiojiri (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Shiojiri city emblem in white: a cog-like disc of segments around a central device.
history: Municipal flag of Shiojiri, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 May 1959.

features.role: Shiojiri city emblem — a cog-like disc of segments around a central device
